description: User corrects the map target: identify and show the proposed solar construction area rather than a nearby cement-plant listing. Establish the proposed array location from county project plans and geographic landmarks or public geospatial evidence; correct the Google Maps embed and labels, retain provenance and uncertainty, avoid claiming surveyed registration. comments.text: Located the actual proposed array areas from C000, replacing the cement-plant listing. Twelve checks pass, including registration/footprint integrity and Google links falling inside each proposed area near its center. Local map/footprint/source/modal/3D camera round-trip verified without errors. Approximate planning localization, not survey accuracy; construction status unverified. Private publication pending.
